runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$4.55** (close 2026-10-16, Yahoo Finance chart API, aggregator, flagged; OTC, thin, 6,733 shares traded that day). Shares **5,190,024** common (10-Q for the quarter to 2026-07-31, filed 2026-09-14, `0001683168-26-007107`; `Screens/cover_shares.py` the same; after the one-for-five reverse split effective 2026-07-20, 8-K `0001683168-26-005762`), plus Series A to D convertible preferred whose conversion terms were not read, the count the common alone; cap **$23.6M**. Sovereign **5.43%** (US Treasury 30-year par yield, 2026-10-16). Filings read: 10-K FY2025 (`0001213900-26-016950`), the 10-Q above, the S-1 of 2024-12-27 (`0001213900-24-113092`, audited FY2022 to FY2024), the Item 4.01 8-K of 2026-02-26 (`0001213900-26-020758`); no statement before FY2022 exists; no Item 1A (smaller reporting company), risks read from the MD&A summary and the S-1. Cross-check: FY2024 revenue $6,891,223 identical in the S-1's audited statement and the 10-K's comparative column. The brief's stated departure: lines of evidence derived by the analyst (the customer and its budget, what a dollar of work earns, what the company will be, and others listed in the run file). Rivals: the 10-K names none; Redwire and Sidus Space read from XBRL company facts as a CONVENTION of the run, no operating profit at either in any year read. `tools/run.py` returned no overlapping data, every figure transcribed by hand. **Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE)** **[M2002-092]**, **[L2007-015]**, **[M2008-088]**, **[L2009-005]**: the ten-year earning power turns on a decade of NASA science appropriations, which the filer calls "a material uncertainty for our future growth", about 70% of FY2025 revenue from the U.S. government, three customers over 67%, one NASA prime 31%, customers served down from 13 to 6, revenue $9.21M FY2023, $3.88M FY2025, $1.54M in the nine months to 2026-07-31 (down 54%), fees "limited by government or agency policies", about twelve employees, no patents; the stated growth plan is an undemonstrated space-based solar power venture with a first demonstration planned for 2030. After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged **[M2013-088]**: secured notes of $900,000 and $250,000 unpaid at maturity in November 2025 with default notices; the chief executive from 2026-01-05 paid in shares (600,000 post-split) and a $1 salary, his son hired the same day as investor-relations manager with 250,000 shares; the CFO's salary payable only once $10M is raised; buybacks partly before board authorisation while a note converts at 65% of the lowest recent close; the 10-K features an "$811B lifetime profit" projection; the auditor dismissed four days after signing the FY2025 opinion; five late-filing notices; common shares up 128% in nine months, an evergreen equity plan; going-concern doubt. Balance sheets FY2021 to FY2025 and 2026-07-31 (five year-ends, not eight to ten): equity near $0.95M through FY2023, no goodwill, a $(4.06)M deficit at FY2025; borrowings $0.43M to $3.42M; cash $7,305 at FY2025; debt converted to shares in 2026, a $1.66M derivative liability. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash (operating cash less capital spending, stock pay and stock for services) FY2022 to FY2025 $(149,590), $(197,016), $(1,756,812), $(2,621,022), four-year average **$(1,181,110)** (the four filed years, a CONVENTION of the run), trailing twelve months $(5,444,939); the no-growth case alone, **$(4.06)** a share all-equity, $(4.19) equity-only, against $4.55; fair **$(2.25)** all-equity, **$(2.28)** equity-only; no case earns the floor at any positive price; not armed. No research pass (NATURE). Contamination declared by the analyst: one filename filter of the `Test Runs/` listing for "hleo", "helio", "web3" and "stirling" before reading the blind rule's full reach, printing nothing; the git status folder names (AYI, ARCB), the CHYCY and BLGO commit subjects and a memory line; none used. Commits 35c1f0cd (Step 0 to Q1), cf661bd5 (computation and close). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_ids.py` PASS, 21 fragments; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_verify.py`, 31 fragments within 300 characters before an id, 9 flags each read and found to be a filing quote preceding the row's own quotation, **no slip**, no E-ids. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) no question clearly owns a single-customer government-budget risk, the same name closable OUT at Q2 by another analyst; (2) the fair price where owner cash is negative every year is a negative number that is not a price, the text could say "none"; (3) no rule for a history shorter than five years; (4) no rule for a conversion derivative or mezzanine preferred in net debt; (5) the template's eight to ten balance sheets from a filer with five. Could not get: any statement before FY2022, an Item 1A, the preferred conversion terms, the status of the defaulted notes at 2026-07-31; the DEF 14C and the 2026 financing 8-Ks not read (the file closed at Q1).

Integrity facts recorded, not judged: secured notes unpaid at maturity, the new chief executive and his son paid in shares, an $811B profit projection in the 10-K, the auditor dismissed four days after the opinion, five late-filing notices, going-concern doubt. Computation beneath the stop: owner cash negative every filed year, four-year average $(1.18)M; value $(4.06) a share all-equity, fair $(2.25) all-equity, $(2.28) equity-only, against $4.55; not armed.
